purpose: Caches and applies reusable R6 and R15 avatar body parts and packages, with server-authoritative replacement rules.
description: AvatarCatalogService lets each game register explicit body assets, load Roblox bundles or legacy packages once, apply catalog entries on demand, dynamically replace disallowed parts or complete packages for every player, and optionally enforce a conservative built-in unfair-avatar list.

Binders/AvatarCatalogHumanoid.luau.description: Owns catalog update observation and avatar enforcement for one PlayerHumanoidBinder-bound humanoid.

Binders/AvatarCatalogHumanoidBinder.luau.description: Provides the PlayerHumanoidBinder that owns AvatarCatalogHumanoid lifetimes.

Catalog/AvatarCatalogCache.luau.description: Caches bundle, outfit, legacy package, and product metadata lookups for the lifetime of the server.

AvatarCatalogService.luau.description: Registers and applies cached R6/R15 body catalogs and enforces dynamic replacement rules after player appearances load.

AvatarCatalogServiceInterface.luau.description: Tie contract used by bound humanoids to observe policy updates and request enforcement.

AvatarCatalogServiceTypes.luau.description: Type contracts for avatar body parts, packages, scales, catalogs, and replacement rules.

AvatarCatalogServiceUtils.luau.description: Stateless validation, copying, matching, and HumanoidDescription transformation helpers.

Catalog/WellKnownUnfairPackagesAndParts..description: Read-only identities for the conservative built-in list of Roblox-authored packages and body parts with substantially reduced visible geometry.
